portInfo.description: Visit Greece paints Kefalonia as lush Ionian terrain with Argostoli as cosmopolitan capital, Fiskardo’s preserved architecture (post-1953 earthquake contrast), Assos’s Venetian castle, and beaches including Myrtos. LTDKI contact: Metaxa Ioanni, 281 00 Argostoli; +30 26710 26541; ltkefa@gmail.com; Coast Guard kefalonia@hcg.gr.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Argostoli cruise pier (north mole) — Argostoli harbour, Kefalonia
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Town is adjacent per LTDKI. Melissani/Sami and Myrtos are cross-island drives — no invented minutes.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Town is adjacent per LTDKI. Melissani/Sami and Myrtos are cross-island drives — no invented minutes.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Argostoli waterfront / town — immediate connection to the harbour per LTDKI.
Melissani Cave — highlight on Visit Greece materials; plan a timed road trip.
Myrtos viewpoint — only with a generous buffer; confirm parking and hours locally.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: If the north mole is occupied, expect anchorage and tender service — budget extra queue time when several ships are in the area.
